result.rationale: In refreshOAuthTokens, the sync path returns a raw `fetch` Response, while the native path returns an axios response. The zohocrm caller (diff line `const zohoCrmTokenInfo = await refreshOAuthTokens(...)`) then immediately accesses `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error` / `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.expiryDate`, which would be undefined for a fetch Response, causing the sync path to misparse/mishandle the token response. Same pattern affects zoho-bigin.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/zohocrm/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the code assigns `zohoCrmTokenInfo` from `refreshOAuthTokens(...)` and then immediately accesses `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error`. However, `refreshOAuthTokens` (new in `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`) returns a `fetch(...)` Response object when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` is true, not an Axios response. A Fetch `Response` does not have a `.data` field, so on the sync path `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data` will be `undefined`, breaking the refresh logic.
